description:
Sobre a vaga


Vaga: Estágio em Marketing e Redes Sociais

Estamos em busca de um(a) estagiário(a) dinâmico(a) para atuar no setor de Marketing, contribuindo ativamente para a nossa presença digital por meio do relacionamento diário com nossa comunidade nas redes sociais, auxiliando na produção de conteúdos multimídia e dando apoio operacional em nossas rotinas de publicação.


Tipo de vaga:

  • Trabalho Remoto (Home Office) | Estágio não obrigatório.


Salário:

  • R$1.067,90


Regime

  • Home office


Jornada:

  • 30h semanais


Benefícios:

  • Auxílio-alimentação de R$364,06;
  • Auxílio-saúde de R$98,65;
  • Auxílio home-office de R$123,78;
  • Vale-inglês: curso de inglês completo + exclusivo instrutor de idioma por IA, disponível para o colaborador e um dependente;
  • Vale-alemão: curso de alemão + exclusivo instrutor de idioma por IA, disponível para o colaborador e um dependente;
  • Clude Saúde: consultas médicas + nutricionista + desconto em farmácias;
  • C4Life: terapia online, diagnóstico e análise de comportamento, coaching, consultorias jurídicas, e mais;
  • Totalpass: 20 mil academias e estúdios, totalplay, totalclub, queima diária, terapia, nutrição;
  • Grupo de motivação fitness;
  • Bradesco Odonto: opção por contribuição, aberto a dependentes, com urgência, 2 limpezas por ano e exames + clube de vantagens.
  • Treinamentos em vendas, marketing e gestão;
  • Kit de boas vindas;
  • #EUVISTOACAMISA: novas camisetas da escola a cada novo ano de empresa;
  • Day-off no aniversário + presente surpresa;
  • Convênio com o SESC: clubes, hospedagem, cursos, eventos e serviços para família;
  • Bônus Indique e Ganhe.


Principais atividades:

As principais atribuições do(a) estagiário(a) se darão no auxílio às tarefas de:

  • Gestão de Comunidades: Auxiliar no monitoramento e na interação ativa com o público, respondendo a comentários, mensagens diretas (DMs) e dúvidas em todas as nossas plataformas (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube e Blog);
  • Produção de Conteúdo: Auxiliar na criação de materiais visuais atrativos para as redes sociais (carrosséis, posts estáticos e stories) e na redação de descrições (copies) engajadoras;
  • Gestão de Publicações: Dar apoio ao agendamento e à postagem de conteúdos em múltiplos canais, incluindo redes sociais, WordPress (artigos), YouTube (upload de aulas) e grupos de transmissão (WhatsApp, Telegram e Discord);
  • Suporte Estratégico e Administrativo: Participar de reuniões de alinhamento, apoiar operacionalmente a equipe e auxiliar na atualização de planilhas de controle.


Perfil:

  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Boa organização e gestão de tempo;
  • Autonomia e disciplina para atuar e render bem em um ambiente 100% remoto (Home Office);
  • Perfil proativo e curioso com vontade real de aprender, se desenvolver profissionalmente e trazer novas ideias para a equipe.


Requisitos :

  • Familiaridade como usuário e criador nas principais plataformas (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok e Telegram);
  • Dispor de um ambiente tranquilo para trabalhar, com internet estável, smartphone e um computador com bom processamento, equipado com webcam, mouse e teclado;
  • Vídeo de apresentação devidamente enviado (instruções abaixo).


Diferenciais (não obrigatório) :

  • Conhecimento prático em Canva para o auxílio na produção de peças visuais rápidas (stories, carrosséis, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com o uso de IAs generativas (ChatGPT, Gemini , etc.) para auxiliar em pesquisas, ideias e otimização de rotinas;
  • Experiência básica com Notion para acompanhamento de tarefas;
  • Conhecimento básico em WordPress (focado na postagem e formatação de artigos);
  • Domínio do idioma inglês e/ou alemão .


Preferencialmente, deve estar cursando :

  • Marketing;
  • Jornalismo;
  • Relações Internacionais;
  • Administração de Empresas;
  • Publicidade e Propaganda;
  • Relações Públicas;
  • Comunicação Social;
  • Gestão Comercial;
  • Comércio Exterior;
  • Design Gráfico.


Sobre a empresa:

  • A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma edtech brasileira, fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-inglês. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina. No inglês, destaca-se com metodologia inovadora de aprendizagem acelerada e índice de 98,9% de satisfação. A empresa irá capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês, possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e tem valor de mercado superior a 30 milhões de reais.

  • Totalpass: 20 mil academias e estúdios, totalplay, totalclub, queima diária, terapia, nutrição;
  • Grupo de motivação fitness;
  • Bradesco Odonto: opção por contribuição, aberto a dependentes, com urgência, 2 limpezas por ano e exames + clube de vantagens.

  • Kit de boas vindas;
  • #EUVISTOACAMISA: novas camisetas da escola a cada novo ano de empresa;
  • Day-off no aniversário + presente surpresa;
  • Convênio com o SESC: clubes, hospedagem, cursos, eventos e serviços para família;
  • Bônus Indique e Ganhe.


Principais atividades:

As principais atribuições do(a) estagiário(a) se darão no auxílio às tarefas de:

  • Gestão de Comunidades: Auxiliar no monitoramento e na interação ativa com o público, respondendo a comentários, mensagens diretas (DMs) e dúvidas em todas as nossas plataformas (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, TikTok, YouTube e Blog);
  • Produção de Conteúdo: Auxiliar na criação de materiais visuais atrativos para as redes sociais (carrosséis, posts estáticos e stories) e na redação de descrições (copies) engajadoras;
  • Gestão de Publicações: Dar apoio ao agendamento e à postagem de conteúdos em múltiplos canais, incluindo redes sociais, WordPress (artigos), YouTube (upload de aulas) e grupos de transmissão (WhatsApp, Telegram e Discord);
  • Suporte Estratégico e Administrativo: Participar de reuniões de alinhamento, apoiar operacionalmente a equipe e auxiliar na atualização de planilhas de controle.


Perfil:

  • Boa comunicação escrita e verbal;
  • Boa organização e gestão de tempo;
  • Autonomia e disciplina para atuar e render bem em um ambiente 100% remoto (Home Office);
  • Perfil proativo e curioso com vontade real de aprender, se desenvolver profissionalmente e trazer novas ideias para a equipe.


Requisitos :

  • Familiaridade como usuário e criador nas principais plataformas (Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, YouTube, TikTok e Telegram);
  • Dispor de um ambiente tranquilo para trabalhar, com internet estável, smartphone e um computador com bom processamento, equipado com webcam, mouse e teclado;
  • Vídeo de apresentação devidamente enviado (instruções abaixo).


Diferenciais (não obrigatório) :

  • Conhecimento prático em Canva para o auxílio na produção de peças visuais rápidas (stories, carrosséis, etc.);
  • Familiaridade com o uso de IAs generativas (ChatGPT, Gemini , etc.) para auxiliar em pesquisas, ideias e otimização de rotinas;
  • Experiência básica com Notion para acompanhamento de tarefas;
  • Conhecimento básico em WordPress (focado na postagem e formatação de artigos);
  • Domínio do idioma inglês e/ou alemão .


Preferencialmente, deve estar cursando :

  • Marketing;
  • Jornalismo;
  • Relações Internacionais;
  • Administração de Empresas;
  • Publicidade e Propaganda;
  • Relações Públicas;
  • Comunicação Social;
  • Gestão Comercial;
  • Comércio Exterior;
  • Design Gráfico.


Sobre a empresa:

  • A Sprache&Wissen (S&W) é uma edtech brasileira, fundada por dois irmãos mineiros: um administrador formado pelo CEFET-MG e uma professora doutora pela UFMG. O grupo educacional administra as marcas Clube de Alemão, Punkify e Vale-inglês. A S&W é a maior escola online de alemão da América Latina. No inglês, destaca-se com metodologia inovadora de aprendizagem acelerada e índice de 98,9% de satisfação. A empresa irá capacitar 100 mil brasileiros até 2030 nos idiomas alemão e inglês, possui mais de 500 mil seguidores nas redes sociais e tem valor de mercado superior a 30 milhões de reais.

description:
Come to one of the biggest IT Services companies in the world!! Here you can transform your career!

The ideal scenario to expand ideas through the right tools, contributing to our success in a collaborative environment.

We are looking for Data Scientist Tech Lead who wants to learn and transform his career.

title: Sr. Compliance OnBoarding Specialist
description:
About the Role


We are looking for a highly motivated and detail-oriented Senior Compliance Onboarding Specialist to join our growing team at Velafi. In this role, you will be instrumental in managing and enhancing the onboarding and KYC (Know Your Customer) processes for our clients across multiple jurisdictions, with a strong focus on Brazil and Latin America.


You will collaborate closely with Sales, Operations, and Compliance teams to design efficient, scalable onboarding frameworks that deliver a seamless customer experience while maintaining strict adherence to regulatory requirements. This position is ideal for someone who thrives in a fast-paced fintech environment and is passionate about balancing compliance excellence with business enablement.


Key Responsibilities


  • Contribute to the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of onboarding controls, policies, and procedures to ensure efficiency, scalability, and regulatory compliance.
  • Act as the subject matter expert for onboarding clients operating in Brazil, ensuring alignment with Brazilian local AML/CTF regulations and industry best practices.
  • Perform detailed reviews and analysis of B2B customer documentation, including Customer Risk Assessments and Customer Due Diligence to support informed onboarding decisions.
  • Partner with Sales, Operations, and other internal stakeholders to provide clear guidance on compliance requirements, enabling smooth client onboarding and expansion into new markets. Advise internal teams on AML risks and regulatory considerations when entering new industries or geographic regions.
  • Conduct background checks, adverse media screenings, and ongoing monitoring of clients and prospects to identify and mitigate potential risks.
  • Support the Compliance function in applying regulatory frameworks across LATAM jurisdictions, ensuring compliant operations in Brazil matters.


What We’re Looking For


  • Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field, with a strong foundation in Compliance.
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in Compliance, preferably within fintech, digital banking, payments, or financial services environments.
  • Strong knowledge of KYC, AML, CDD, and CRA frameworks
  • Solid understanding of Brazilian AML/CTF regulations
  • Familiarity with international regulatory standards, including BSA, USA PATRIOT Act, and OFAC
  • Ability to evaluate complex customer structures, identify risks, and make sound compliance decisions.
  • Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to work cross-functionally and communicate complex regulatory concepts clearly.
  • Fluent in Spanish (English is a strong plus).
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable operating in a dynamic, fast-growing environment with evolving regulatory landscapes.

This is a plug-and-play role for a senior commercial professional who brings an established network and deep sector understanding. You will act as a market-opening engine, converting your credibility and relationships into new logos and meaningful ARR growth.

  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.

  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.

  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.

  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.



Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

Trabajamos con líderes de los sectores alimentario, de bebidas, textil y financiero para medir, reducir y reportar el impacto ambiental de sus cadenas de suministro agrícolas. Nuestra plataforma combina ciencia agronómica, sensores remotos y analítica de datos para ayudar a las organizaciones a alcanzar sus objetivos de sostenibilidad, apoyando al mismo tiempo a los productores en la transición hacia prácticas regenerativas.


Sobre el Rol

Como Commercial Lead — Brasil, impulsarás el crecimiento comercial de Regrow en uno de nuestros mercados más estratégicos. Este es un rol de ciclo completo enfocado en nuevos negocios: abrirás nuevas cuentas, construirás y calificarás pipeline, y cerrarás acuerdos enterprise con clientes a lo largo de las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial de Brasil.


Trabajarás en estrecha colaboración con nuestra Directora de LatAm, el equipo global de go-to-market y la organización de customer success para llevar la plataforma de Regrow a marcas de alimentos y bebidas, empresas textiles, productores de biocombustibles, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, traders, bancos e instituciones financieras que operan en las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos.


Este es un rol plug-and-play para un profesional comercial senior que aporte una red establecida y un profundo conocimiento sectorial. Actuarás como motor de apertura de mercado, convirtiendo tu credibilidad y relaciones en nuevos logos y crecimiento significativo de ARR.


Qué Harás

  • Serás dueño del ciclo comercial completo de nuevos negocios en Brasil: prospección, descubrimiento, calificación, propuesta, negociación y cierre.
  • Abrirás puertas con tomadores de decisiones senior y sponsors ejecutivos en cuentas objetivo estratégicas.
  • Construirás y mantendrás un pipeline calificado proveniente exclusivamente de nuevas cuentas, con disciplina en CRM y precisión en el forecast.
  • Expandirás la presencia de Regrow en verticales prioritarias: CPG, textiles, biocombustibles, agronegocios, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos e instituciones financieras.
  • Posicionarás a Regrow con credibilidad dentro de las cadenas de valor de granos, carne vacuna y lácteos de Brasil, adaptando nuestra narrativa al contexto local.
  • Colaborarás con los equipos globales de GTM, producto, ciencia y customer success para estructurar acuerdos complejos y asegurar transiciones post-cierre fluidas.
  • Proporcionarás inteligencia estructurada de mercado sobre dinámicas competitivas, necesidades de compradores, barreras de adopción y señales regulatorias.
  • Representarás a Regrow en conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Qué Aportarás

  • Experiencia comprobada en hunting y apertura de nuevas cuentas enterprise en entornos B2B complejos.
  • Historial de cierre de nuevos negocios y una red activa que pueda ser activada en el corto plazo.
  • Fuerte presencia en agronegocios con acceso real a tomadores de decisiones en las cadenas de valor agrícola y agroindustrial.
  • Comprensión profunda de los ecosistemas agroalimentarios brasileños y de compradores como CPGs, traders, cooperativas, procesadores, frigoríficos, bancos e instituciones financieras.
  • Experiencia en o fuerte afinidad con climate tech, sostenibilidad, agricultura regenerativa, huella de carbono, MRV, trazabilidad o plataformas SaaS.
  • Presencia ejecutiva y credibilidad para relacionarse con compradores senior como socio comercial, no como vendedor transaccional.
  • Capacidad para traducir temas técnicos y científicos en propuestas comerciales claras y concretas.
  • Comodidad operando en un entorno matricial con equipos globales y en contextos dinámicos de alto crecimiento.
  • Dominio nativo o casi nativo del portugués.
  • Dominio profesional del inglés, con capacidad para presentar y colaborar con stakeholders globales de manera regular.
  • Disponibilidad para viajar según sea necesario para conferencias del sector y reuniones con clientes en todo Brasil.



Deseable

  • Experiencia reciente en scale-ups, startups o empresas de tecnología de alto crecimiento.
  • Experiencia vendiendo categorías innovadoras a industrias tradicionales.
  • Conocimiento funcional del español.



Por Qué Regrow

  • Misión con propósito: dar forma al futuro de la agricultura y contribuir a construir resiliencia climática a escala.
  • Entorno de alto crecimiento tipo scale-up con autonomía y responsabilidad real.
  • Un equipo global colaborativo que combina experiencia comercial, científica y técnica.
  • Compensación y beneficios competitivos.

title: Senior Python Developer
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


Step into the world of advanced software engineering as our Senior Python Developer, where you'll architect sophisticated solutions for global clients. This isn't just about coding, it's about leading technical initiatives, mentoring rising talent, and solving complex challenges using Python's powerful ecosystem while driving innovation in cloud environments, data processing, and web development.


Key responsibilities:


- Create automation systems and tools to configure, monitor, and orchestrate data infrastructure and pipelines.

- Develop data integration services that accelerate customer onboarding processes.

- Ensure reliability, performance, and support of data infrastructure with solutions aligned to application needs and growth projections.

- Lead the design and implementation of complex Python applications.

- Guide junior developers through comprehensive code reviews and technical mentoring.

- Architect scalable solutions using modern design patterns and industry best practices.

- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform business requirements into technical specifications.


Requirements:


- 5+ years of hands-on experience in Python and Django development.

- Experience with SQL and NoSQL Databases.

- Experience with Microservices and Cloud environments.

- Advanced algorithm knowledge.

- Intermediate agile methodologies management.

- Strong understanding of best practices, SOLID principles, CLEAN Code, and scalable solutions.

- Design Patterns knowledge.

- Experience developing entire applications from scratch.

- Experience in automated tests, CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong experience with version control.

- Strong experience with Unit testing, integration testing, and code coverage.

- Advanced English proficiency.


Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Go Developer
description:
Senior Go Developer

Brazil

Software Engineer Lead


Important Information


Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


As a Senior Software Engineer Backend you will be part of a fast-paced, collaborative team developing our attack surface intelligence capabilities. You will be a critical contributor to the development and integration of reconnaissance technologies and products while also moving forward the state of engineering best practices in our cybersecurity platform. If you enjoy pivoting between different problems and meeting new challenges every day while developing solutions that are mission critical to the organization, this role is for you!

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Develop and integrate cybersecurity testing and analysis systems with best-in-class cybersecurity platform;
  • Build high-performance, resilient, scalable cloud-based software, microservices architecture and containers;
  • Take software through CI/CD all the way to production and own its quality and availability;
  • Utilize GCP platform to build and run highly-available software systems;
  • Identify and resolve performance issues across systems and components;
  • Collaborate on a cross-functional team, working with Product, Operations, and Platform Engineering;
  • Integrate monitoring and alerting capabilities with backend modules to allow proactive improvements to availability and response times;
  • Design, implement and deliver well-tested, scalable, highly available systems;
  • Own and ideate technical solutions for product requirements and user stories;
  • Actively engage and participate in design and code reviews;
  • Offer guidance and support to junior team members, encouraging and cultivating a culture of continuous learning within the team

Essential Skills


  • Experience in distributed-systems and backend software engineering;
  • Strong Golang Required;
  • Strong experience and understanding of microservices, REST API design, gRPC, unit testing, BDD testing;
  • Strong design skills required – UML is a bonus; exposure to Domain Driven Design desirable;
  • Experience with asynchronous messaging technologies such as Google PubSub, Kafka;
  • In depth knowledge of NoSQL and RDBMS technologies;
  • Strong experience with Docker, Kubernetes, Cloud Environments (GCP preferred);
  • Experience working on agile teams;
  • Experience developing scalable and observable microservice-based applications
  • Experience with GitOps and DevOps principles, practices and tools;
  • A proven ability to thrive in a collaborative environment involving different stakeholders and subject matter experts
  • Advanced English skills.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Interest in security / penetration testing;
  • Interest in GenAI and LLM technologies.

About Encora


Encora is the preferred digital engineering and modernization partner of some of the world’s leading enterprises and digital native companies. With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.


At Encora, we hire professionals based solely on their skills and qualifications, and do not discriminate based on age, disability, religion, gender, sexual orientation, socioeconomic status, or nationality.

description:
O Mercado Eletrônico é líder na América Latina em soluções de gestão de compras B2B. Suas tecnologias e serviços para as áreas de compras ajudam empresas a conquistarem mais economia, agilidade, governança e colaboração.

Com escritórios no Brasil, Estados Unidos, México e Portugal, contabiliza mais de 1 milhão de fornecedores, 10 mil compradores e transaciona um valor acima de R$ 160 bilhões em negócios anualmente. É a única empresa latino-americana a fazer parte do Quadrante Mágico S2P (source-to-pay), do Gartner.


Gerente de Projetos Sr

contratação CLT

  • ntender requisitos gerais do projeto vendido (pré-vendas, consultoria e comercial);

  • Diretiva – exercer a cogestão em projetos críticos, atuando como facilitador técnico-funcional na Plataforma ME e mediador estratégico no relacionamento com o cliente para viabilizar o cronograma;
  • Suporte – prover suporte metodológico e garantir a integridade do portfólio sob gestão da Consultoria, monitorando prazos e entregáveis.;
  • Realizar a gestão proativa de riscos e issues, antecipando desvios que possam impactar o sucesso da implantação no cliente;
  • Garantir a aderência ao escopo contratado, gerenciando as expectativas do cliente e das consultorias em relação a itens de não-escopo;
  • Formalizar a aceitação das documentações, produtos e fases do projeto;
  • Elaborar e apresentar relatórios de status do projeto;


Será bacana se você tiver:

  • Superior completo Ciências da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia da Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Experiência sólida na implantação de plataformas SaaS/PaaS, com foco em integração de sistemas e substituição de sistemas legados;
  • Conhecimento no processo de Compras (Procurement) será um diferencial;
  • Experiência prévia com a Plataforma Mercado Eletrônico ou soluções correlatas de mercado será considerada um diferencial relevante;
  • Fluência em inglês e/ou espanhol será um diferencial;
  • Conhecimento avançado de MS Project ou ferramenta similar;
  • Conhecimento avançado de algumas metodologias de gestão de projetos (PMBoK /Ágil/ Outras);
  • Soft skills: comunicação, negociação e liderança;
  • Atributos de resiliência: positividade, foco, flexibilidade, organização e proatividade;
  • Bom relacionamento interpessoal;

title: Engenheiro(a) de Dados - Tech Lead
description:
Aqui na CWI Software, estamos em busca de um(a) Tech Lead Engenheiro(a) de Dados para atuar em contrato CLT, no modelo remoto , junto a um cliente do segmento financeiro de grande porte, referência no mercado nacional.


Você irá atuar em projetos de alta complexidade, com alto rigor técnico, segurança e escalabilidade, contribuindo diretamente para soluções críticas e estratégicas no setor financeiro.


Responsabilidades

  • Liderar tecnicamente a construção e evolução de pipelines de dados Batch e Streaming;
  • Definir e evoluir arquiteturas de dados baseadas em Data Lake e Lakehouse;
  • Atuar na modelagem e engenharia de dados, garantindo escalabilidade e qualidade das soluções;
  • Implementar e supervisionar processos de ingestão, transformação e qualidade de dados (Data Ingestion, Transformation e Data Quality);
  • Atuar de forma colaborativa com áreas de negócio e times técnicos, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em soluções técnicas;
  • Promover boas práticas de governança e controle de acesso a dados;
  • Atuar como referência técnica para o time, incentivando colaboração, visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.


Requisitos obrigatórios

  • Experiência sólida com pipelines de dados Batch e Streaming;
  • Experiência com arquitetura de dados (Data Lake e Lakehouse);
  • Experiência com modelagem e engenharia de dados;
  • Conhecimento em processos de ingestão, transformação e qualidade de dados;
  • Experiência com Databricks;
  • Experiência com Azure;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e NoSQL;
  • Experiência com Kafka e mensageria;
  • Conhecimento em governança e controle de acesso a dados;
  • Comunicação sólida com áreas de negócio e times técnicos;
  • Capacidade de transformar problemas de negócio em soluções técnicas;
  • Visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico;
  • Capacidade de influência técnica e colaboração com o time.

Certificação Databricks.

title: Senior Data Engineer
description:
Senior Data Engineer (Oracle / ODI) – Data Warehouse & ETL Specialist

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer with strong expertise in Oracle and ODI (Oracle Data Integrator) to join our team and support enterprise-grade data initiatives.

This role is ideal for professionals who thrive in complex data environments , working with large-scale Data Warehouses and mission-critical systems — especially within financial services or similar industries.

You will be responsible for designing, developing, and optimizing ETL/ELT pipelines , ensuring high standards of data quality, performance, and reliability .

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop ETL/ELT processes using ODI
  • Build and maintain scalable Data Warehouse solutions
  • Develop complex SQL and PL/SQL logic (procedures, packages, functions)
  • Implement data quality, reconciliation, and auditing frameworks
  • Optimize performance (SQL tuning, indexing, partitioning)
  • Develop and manage ODI Load Plans and workflows
  • Troubleshoot and debug data pipelines and mappings
  • Translate business requirements into technical specifications
  • Integrate multiple data sources (databases, files, APIs)

Required Qualifications

  • 6+ years of experience in Data Engineering / ETL development
  • 3+ years of hands-on experience with Oracle Data Integrator (ODI)
  • Strong expertise in Oracle SQL and PL/SQL
  • Proven experience in Data Warehouse implementations (end-to-end)
  • Deep understanding of ETL/ELT concepts and data modeling
  • Experience with:
  • ODI Topology, Designer, Operator
  • Knowledge Modules (KM)
  • Load Plans and scheduling
  • Error handling and data reconciliation
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Ability to work independently in fast-paced environments
  • Fluent or advanced English communication skills

Nice to Have

  • Experience in financial services industry
  • Exposure to modern data platforms (Databricks, Snowflake, etc.)
  • Cloud experience (AWS, Azure, or GCP)

What We Offer

  • Opportunity to work on high-impact enterprise data projects
  • Collaborative and technically strong team environment
  • Exposure to both legacy and modern data architectures
  • Career growth aligned with evolving data technologies

Apply Now

If you are passionate about data engineering and enjoy solving complex data challenges, we’d love to hear from you. Send to

title: Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant
description:
Job Summary

Client is seeking a senior-level Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions. This individual will be a hands-on consultant responsible for developing scalable planning models, supporting integrations across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms, and partnering with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to deliver business-critical planning capabilities. The ideal candidate will bring deep Adaptive Planning expertise, strong financial planning knowledge, and the ability to translate business requirements into high-impact system solutions.


Key Responsibilities

  • Architect, design, and build scalable planning models in Workday Adaptive Planning
  • Develop and optimize complex models including dimensions, sheets, versions, assumptions, and driver-based logic
  • Design, support, and improve integrations and data workflows across Adaptive Planning and Oracle platforms
  • Partner with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT teams to translate planning requirements into sustainable system solutions
  • Troubleshoot model and integration issues and improve overall system performance, scalability, and usability
  • Create clear documentation and provide knowledge transfer to support long-term ownership and adoption
  • Act as a senior consultant, owning delivery quality and supporting key stakeholder relationships


Required Qualifications

  • 5+ years of hands-on Workday Adaptive Planning experience
  • Proven experience architecting and building Adaptive Planning solutions, not just maintaining existing models
  • Deep expertise in:
  • Dimensions
  • Sheets
  • Versions
  • Assumptions
  • Driver-based planning logic
  • Complex calculations
  • Performance tuning and model optimization
  • Proven experience integrating Workday Adaptive Planning with Oracle EPM and/or Oracle ERP
  • Strong understanding of planning data structures, financial data flows, and integration best practices
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning and FP&A processes , including budgeting and forecasting
  • Ability to connect technical configuration decisions to business and financial outcomes
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to explain complex models to non-technical stakeholders
  • Experience working cross-functionally with Finance, RevOps, Data, and IT

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience supporting SaaS or recurring revenue business models
  • Experience leading or influencing Adaptive Planning best practices and standards
  • Background in multi-entity or high-growth organizations
  • Prior consulting or advisory experience in complex planning environments

Ideal Candidate Profile

  • Senior, hands-on consultant comfortable owning solution delivery end to end
  • Strong technical builder with business-facing communication skills
  • Able to operate independently while partnering across multiple functional teams
  • Skilled at balancing architecture, execution, troubleshooting, and stakeholder management

Combinando tecnologia de ponta e conhecimento médico, estamos moldando o futuro da saúde e proporcionando impacto positivo na vida de milhões de pessoas.


*O QUE PROCURAMOS: *


Você será responsável por realizar consultas por vídeo e telefone, por intermédio de plataforma do empregador, atendendo na especialidade de Nefrologia , de forma ética, com abordagem biopsicossocial do processo saúde-adoecimento, integrando ações de prevenção, promoção, proteção, recuperação e educação em saúde buscando alcançar os melhores resultados clínicos.


*PAPEIS E RESPONSABILIDADES*


  • Fornecer atendimento médico especializado em Nefrologia de forma remota, através de consultas e avaliações realizadas por meio de plataformas digitais de comunicação.


  • Experiência e conhecimento para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.


  • Realizar consultas em Telemedicina sendo capaz de: conduzir anmneses virtuais para coletar queixas e histórico médico, realizar exame clínico e avaliações à distância, interpretar resultados de exames laboratoriais e de imagem, elaborar diagnósticos precisos, propor medidas terapêuticas e orientações de cuidado, reconhecer sinais de gravidade em Nefrologia e critérios para encaminhar ao atendimento presencial.


  • Habilidade em conduzir entrevistas detalhadas e observar sintomas e sinais da especialidade Nefrologia através de videochamadas.


  • Atuar de forma a priorizar a prática médica centrada na pessoa.


  • Elaborar planos de tratamento individualizados, levando em consideração as necessidades específicas de cada paciente.


  • Ser hábil na prescrição de medicamentos adequados para tratar doenças nefrológicas.


  • Monitorar o progresso dos pacientes ao longo do tratamento em telemedicina.


  • Realizar ajustes no plano de tratamento, conforme necessário, com base na resposta do paciente ao tratamento.


  • Desenvolver atividades integrais de saúde, incorporando prevenção e promoção de saúde para dar as respostas mais adequadas às necessidades de saúde apresentadas.


  • Atender com elevado grau de qualidade, sendo resolutivo na grande maioria das orientações acerca de problemas de saúde em Nefrologia.


  • Considerar os valores e preferências pessoais do paciente conjuntamente às melhores evidências científicas e à experiência de manejo clínico para efetivamente promover a melhor prática clínica e os melhores desfechos em saúde para cada indivíduo.


  • Exercer uso racional de recursos em saúde visando a segurança do paciente e a prevenção quaternária, evitando sobrediagnóstico e sobretratamento, que expõe os indivíduos a maiores riscos do que benefícios em saúde.


  • Estimular a participação e a autonomia dos indivíduos e familiares, fortalecendo a aderência a tratamentos e medidas de autocuidado.


  • Documentar todas as interações e informações relevantes dos pacientes em prontuários eletrônicos seguros e confidenciais.


  • Ter capacidade de crítica de sua própria atividade médica, considerando-a em seus aspectos científicos, éticos e sociais para aprimoramento contínuo.


  • Manter-se bem informado e atualizado, ampliando sua própria competência em relação a conhecimentos sobre riscos em saúde e sobre as medidas mais eficientes para eliminar ou reduzir os riscos relevantes.


  • Respeitar, cumprir e fazer cumprir os ditames do Código de Ética Médica, bem como a Legislação vigente e os regulamentos internos formais da Instituição.

Formação Acadêmica:

  • RESIDÊNCIA MÉDICA CONCLUÍDA OU ESPECIALIZAÇÃO/PÓS EM NEFROLOGIA.


Certificações:

  • Registro ativo no Conselho Regional de Medicina (CRM);
  • Certificado de Título de Especialista em Nefrologia - RQE (Emitido pelo Conselho do respectivo Estado);
  • Certificado Digital Ativo reconhecido pela Infraestrutura de Chaves Públicas Brasileira (ICP-Brasil);



Experiência:

Experiência em atividades relacionadas à atuação em atendimento médico em Nefrologia, sendo desejável experiência prévia em Telemedicina.



Conhecimentos Específicos para a função:

Competência em prestar orientações personalizadas a indivíduos e suas famílias com conhecimentos para o diagnóstico, tratamento e acompanhamento de pacientes com doenças e distúrbios nefrológicos.



Competências Comportamentais:

Comprometimento com os pacientes, com ideais e valores da empresa, apresentando postura ética, pontualidade, capacidade de integração com equipe multiprofissional.



Outros Requisitos Importantes:

Conhecimentos e Habilidades em computação: uso do Pacote Office (Excel, Word, Power Point, Gráficos) e Internet. Familiaridade com tecnologias de telemedicina e uso de plataformas de comunicação virtual é um diferencial desejável.

title: .Net Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (.NET Core & Angular)


Salary: $5,500 – $6,500 USD per month (based on experience)

Schedule: Full-time, Monday–Friday, 8:30 AM – 5:30 PM (EST)

Location: Fully remote (Latin America)


Latino Legends is conducting a search on behalf of one of our innovative, fast-growing clients in the marketing and digital delivery space.


Our client is a technology-driven marketing organization that builds and scales high-performance digital platforms for global brands. They specialize in developing advanced marketing systems, product delivery solutions, and integrated digital experiences that support microsites, social media, and complex backend operations. The company is known for embracing modern technologies, agile practices, and continuous innovation.

This is an exciting opportunity for a Senior Full Stack Developer who enjoys solving complex technical challenges and wants to play a key role across the full Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC).


The Role


As a Senior Full Stack Developer, you will be a key contributor to the client’s technology team. You will go beyond implementation—helping architect, design, and scale applications that power a global digital ecosystem. From backend services to modern frontend interfaces, your work will directly impact performance, scalability, and user experience.


Technical Qualifications & Requirements


  • Experience: 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Backend Expertise: Strong proficiency in C#, .NET, ASP.NET Core/MVC, and Entity Framework. Experience designing RESTful APIs and microservices.
  • Frontend Expertise: Advanced experience with JavaScript/TypeScript and Angular (v12+), including state management, component architecture, and performance optimization.
  • DevOps & Cloud: Hands-on experience with Docker and Kubernetes, plus cloud platforms such as Azure (preferred) or AWS/GCP. Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions).
  • Software Craftsmanship: Solid understanding of design patterns, SOLID principles, unit testing/TDD, and Agile/SCRUM methodologies.
  • Leadership & Collaboration: Comfortable mentoring teammates, participating in code reviews, and contributing to best practices within distributed teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Architect and develop scalable, high-quality applications using modern .NET and Angular frameworks.
  • Collaborate with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into effective technical solutions.
  • Maintain high standards for code quality through documentation, testing, and peer reviews.
  • Research and implement new technologies to keep the platform modern and competitive.


Why Join This Opportunity?


  • Modern, cloud-native technology stack with minimal legacy constraints.
  • Collaborative, professional work environment with high technical standards.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
  • Strong work-life balance with PTO and recognized holidays.

title: Node.js Developer | Senior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Prover soluções técnicas para o desenvolvimento de novas features e dar suporte às features já existentes;
  • Desenvolver e evoluir soluções backend utilizando microserviços e computação serverless, garantindo escalabilidade, alta disponibilidade e resiliência;
  • Desenvolver, manter e evoluir APIs REST e integrações assíncronas com mensagerias;
  • Projetar e implementar soluções backend em Node, utilizando frameworks MVC, bancos de dados relacionais e padrões arquiteturais adequados ao domínio do negócio;
  • Garantir a qualidade contínua do software por meio da implementação de testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia de software, reduzindo débitos técnicos e aumentando a manutenibilidade das aplicações.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Experiência obrigatória e vivência em projetos com Azure Logic Apps
  • Experiência com Node;
  • Habilidade em lógica de programação;
  • Experiência em desenho e detalhamento de soluções técnicas;
  • Conhecimento e experiência em computação Serverless (Azure Functions e AWS Lambda);
  • Vivência prática na implementação de microserviços com comunicação síncrona e assíncrona, em cenários complexos e de alta performance;
  • Conhecimento de ao menos um framework MVC;
  • Experiência profissional com mensageria (SQS, SNS, RabbitMQ ou Kafka), com boa base teórica em tópicos e filas;
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em bancos de dados relacionais (SQL);
  • Experiência no desenvolvimento e consumo de APIs REST;
  • Experiência com testes automatizados (unitários, integração, BDD, entre outros);
  • Experiência com práticas de CI/CD (GitLab CI, Jenkins ou similares);
  • Conhecimento e aplicação de boas práticas como Clean Code, SOLID e conceitos de DDD;
  • Perfil intraempreendedor, com objetivos alinhados aos objetivos da empresa e foco em qualidade de entrega.

title: Supply Chain Analyst - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for a Supply Chain Analyst to join our team and help drive our growth. As a Supply Chain Analyst, you will play a critical and active role in the day-to-day operations. This is an excellent opportunity to be one of the key members of our team and position yourself for unique career growth opportunities.


Key responsibilities:


- Determine supply needs for products and services and research potential suppliers.

- Act as a link and communicate pricing and performance needs to vendors and suppliers.

- Participate in negotiations of favorable procurement contracts and prices with selected vendors and suppliers.

- Select the most suitable suppliers in terms of reliability, product quality, and cost-efficiency.

- Maintain and update a list of suppliers and their qualifications, delivery times, and potential future development.

- Prepare cost-benefit analysis reports for review by managers.


Requirements:


- 2+ years of experience in a supply management role or related position.

- Knowledge of SAP or SAP B1.

- Degree in supply chain management, logistics, business management, or related fields.

- Experience in managing inventory.

- Proficiency in SQL analysis tools and mathematical analysis.

- Interpersonal skills and ability to build and improve trust.

- Advanced level of English.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

title: Product Designer Lead (UX/UI)
description:
⚠️ Professional English is a requirement for this role⚠️

⚠️ A challenge will be required for evaluation ⚠️


About Foundey


Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

Foundey (formerly Uitify) is a design studio specializing in delivering high-quality UI/UX and branding solutions for early-stage SaaS startups based in the United States. We are committed to transforming complex business ideas into elegant, user-centric digital experiences. With a strong emphasis on design excellence, innovation, and client collaboration, we help fast-growing companies establish strong visual identities and seamless digital products.


The Opportunity


We are looking for a experienced and strategic Product Designer. This role is ideal for a designer who thrives on solving complex user problems, designing for technical audiences, and delivering intuitive, scalable product experiences in fast-paced, startup environments.

The ideal candidate is a hands-on product thinker with a deep understanding of user-centered design for B2B software, a track record of shipping enterprise-grade digital products, and experience working closely with Product Managers, Engineers, and key stakeholders in the cybersecurity and SaaS sectors.


Responsibilities


  • Lead end-to-end product design processes, from discovery and research to wireframing, prototyping, and high-fidelity UI design;
  • Partner closely with Product Management and Engineering to define product requirements and translate them into user-centered design solutions;
  • Design intuitive interfaces for complex cybersecurity tools and SaaS products, focusing on usability, scalability, and performance;
  • Conduct user research, usability testing, and heuristic evaluations to validate design decisions and optimize user experience
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to align design goals with business objectives, technical constraints, and customer needs;
  • Create and maintain design systems and UI libraries to ensure consistency and efficiency across the product suite;
  • Stay updated on design trends, user behavior patterns in B2B software, and industry best practices in product design;
  • Mentor junior designers and provide design critique and feedback within the team.


Requirements


  • Full professional proficiency in English (verbal and written), with the ability to clearly articulate design rationale and collaborate with international teams;
  • Strong portfolio showcasing complex product design work for enterprise software, especially in security, data visualization, or technical tools;
  • Deep expertise with design tools like Figma, FigJam, and prototyping tools such as Framer or Principle;
  • Solid understanding of user flows, interaction design, information architecture, and visual hierarchy for B2B software;
  • Experience working in agile development environments, with strong collaboration skills alongside Product Managers and Engineers;
  • Familiarity with design systems, accessibility standards (WCAG), and responsive design principles.


Preferred Qualifications


  • 6+ years of experience as a Product Designer
  • Direct experience designing for cybersecurity platforms (e.g., threat detection tools, security dashboards, monitoring platforms, etc.);
  • Background in designing data-heavy interfaces, with complex user journeys and role-based user permissions;
  • Knowledge of frontend development principles (HTML, CSS) to effectively communicate with developers;
  • Prior experience working with US-based startups or product teams;
  • Experience facilitating design workshops, user interviews, or stakeholder alignment sessions.


Why Join Us?


At Foundey, you will work on high-impact projects for fast-growing SaaS and cybersecurity companies, helping shape the digital tools that protect and empower businesses worldwide. You’ll collaborate with talented designers and technologists, contribute to cutting-edge design solutions, and grow your career in a studio that values innovation, ownership, and excellence.

title: Scrum Master - Fully Remote
description:
Scrum Master – Fully Remote


We are seeking an experienced Scrum Master to support our software and network development teams. You will be responsible for guiding teams in agile principles and practices, removing obstacles, and fostering a culture of continuous improvement and high performance.


Key Responsibilities

  • Facilitate Agile ceremonies – daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and reviews.
  • Coach team members in agile practices and Scrum values to ensure consistent application.
  • Foster collaboration between developers, testers, product owners, and stakeholders.
  • Promote transparency and effective communication within and across teams.
  • Facilitate cross-team coordination when multiple Scrum teams are working on related products or features.


Skills and Qualifications

  • Proven experience as a Scrum Master working with software development teams.
  • Strong understanding of Agile frameworks and principles.
  • Must have experience working in Telecommunications.
  • Excellent facilitation, conflict resolution, and coaching skills.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management abilities.
  • Ability to work in a hectic environment.
  • Certified Scrum Master (CSM), PSM I/II, or equivalent certification.
  • Familiarity with Scaled Agile frameworks (e.g., SAFe, LeSS).
  • Background in software development or QA (is a plus).

title: Salesforce Developer
description:
Title: Salesforce Developer (4856)

Location: Brazil (Remote)

Duration: 6+ Months Contract


Pay: BRL 150-160/hr.


Position Summary

The role of the Salesforce Developer is to create new functionality using declarative (e.g. Formula Fields, Process Builder, Flow) or programmatic (e.g. Apex, Visualforce) methods to meet business requirements. The position has the responsibility for researching solutions, troubleshooting bugs, and enhancing the capabilities of Salesforce within best practices guidelines. In addition to understanding technical aspects of Salesforce such as Integration APIs and data security architecture, the role requires analytical problem solving skills, attention to detail, and ability to set push back against unreasonable expectations.


Essential Duties & Responsibilities

  • Drive the creation of application and technical design documents which leverage Salesforce best practices
  • Solve complex issues using troubleshooting methodologies combined with expert knowledge of Salesforce applications.
  • Work closely with Business Analysts using Agile development techniques to understand requirements and build high quality solutions
  • Develop application fixes for critical issues with declarative (Workflows, Approvals, Formulas, etc…) and programmatic tools (Apex Classes, Triggers, Visualforce, Lightning, etc…)
  • Manage customer expectations; negotiate solutions to complex problems with both the customer and third-party partners
  • Proactively research, present and make recommendations regarding new features made available with each Salesforce release.
  • Perform review of code in collaboration with Administrators, to ensure long term viability & integrity.
  • Make recommendations for enhancements and modifications to improve system performance, efficiency and reporting.
  • Collaborate with team members in a virtual team environment to extend field experience to different geographies.
  • Contribute to the development and management of knowledge-sharing methodologies, diagnostic tools, and creative processes, to improve the end user experience.
  • Be a pro-active contributor to a 24x7x365 running support organization, this will require working flexible hours, including evenings, weekends and holidays and monitoring email regularly outside standard business hours.


Additional Duties & Responsibilities

  • Review technical solutions and documentation developed by other team members
  • Mentor and cross train other team members


Minimal Qualifications

  • Platform Developer I Certification
  • Platform Developer II Certification
  • Platform App Builder Certification
  • Experience in Lightning Web Components


Education

  • Bachelor Degree in Computer Science or related field or equivalent experience


Experience

  • Minimum combined 10 years development experience with CRM applications with 4+ years of hands-on development with Salesforce
  • 4+ years of development in medium to large complexity Salesforce Orgs
  • Deep expertise of Salesforce architecture, administration, best practices, and CRM business concepts.
  • Experience with post-production managed services and support


Skills

  • Hands on Development with Apex, Visualforce, and Lightning Web Components
  • Excellent interpersonal, presentation and communication skills – verbal & written. Ability to communicate at business level with stakeholders and technical level with developers.
  • Practical knowledge of APIs to integrate Salesforce with other data sources.
  • Expertise in customization of Mobile App.
  • Superb trouble-shooting skills and tenacity in problem solving.
  • Strong knowledge of key application functionality, data security, and relationships.
  • Attention to detail and the ability to learn quickly.
  • Ability to work calmly and professionally in high pressure situations.
  • The ability to work effectively from a home-based office in a virtual environment.


Desired Qualifications

  • Integration Architecture Designer Certification
  • Certified Sharing and Visibility Designer
  • A consulting background, while not mandatory, would be useful
  • 2+ Years of Experience in DevOps Environment

title: Desenvolvedor full stack
description:
Required Skills:


  • Fluent in English with excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • 5+ years of industry experience.
  • BS or MS in Computer Science or a related field.
  • Multi-year experience as a full-stack engineer using modern technologies.
  • Experience with Java, Go, and JavaScript frameworks, including Sencha ExtJS.
  • Experience developing applications with SQL databases.
  • Experience with J2EE or JBoss/Wildfly.
  • Strong working knowledge of REST API or GraphQL.
  • Solid understanding of distributed computing and cloud computing concepts.
  • Demonstrated ability to work with QA and remote teams.

  • Experience coding in Python.
  • Experience designing consumer-facing products.
  • Knowledge of PostgreSQL.
  • Experience with network products, including switches, routers, wireless controllers, and access points.
  • Experience working in an Agile environment.

title: Junior Node Developer - Remote Work
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role:


We are looking for Junior Node Developers to join our Development team and participate in different projects made up of multicultural teams distributed throughout the world. We are looking for proactive people, team players passionate about programming in this language and oriented to provide the best experience to the end user. This is an excellent opportunity for those professionals looking to develop in one of the fastest growing companies in the industry!

These developers will face numerous technical challenges, so they must use current technologies, get involved in the mobile world, web applications, devices, etc.


Key responsibilities:


- Architect Bandit backend systems using the best practice.

- Implement and iterate features in a tactical manner and rapid pace.

- Work collaboratively and efficiently across functional teams in a fast paced early stage startup environment.

- Design, extend, and implement APIs.

- High standard of engineering quality through code reviews, unit tests, analytics.

- Create engineering efficiencies through automation and development of tools.

- Define engineering processes for product launch and releases.

- Help us grow the world class engineering team via by running technical interviews.


Requirements:


- 1+ year of experience in Node development.

- Experience in Video and HLS.

- Advanced English level.


Benefits:

• Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

• Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

• Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

• Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

• Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

• Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

• Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

• Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Node/React Fullstack Developer | Senior
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Procurar sempre criar a melhor experiência de uso para o usuário final, trabalhando de forma colaborativa com desenvolvedores, designers e stakeholders para garantir o sucesso dos projetos;
  • Participar ativamente na resolução de problemas complexos, identificando oportunidades de melhoria e propondo soluções inovadoras;
  • Escrever código limpo, testável, de fácil manutenção, utilizando as melhores práticas de desenvolvimento de software;
  • Participar ativamente do processo de revisão de código, atuando tanto como revisor quanto como autor, garantindo a qualidade e a funcionalidade das features desenvolvidas;
  • Acompanhar o comportamento das aplicações em produção usando as principais métricas de saúde e performance disponíveis nas ferramentas de monitoração, buscando insights de melhorias e entendendo anomalias a partir dessas métricas;
  • Atuar no backend que é a interface de consumo dos dados para todos os front-ends, garantindo resiliência e suporte à alta carga de acessos simultâneos;
  • Contribuir com a aplicação responsável pela entrega do site web do produto, utilizando o ambiente como campo de experimentação e aprendizado sobre o comportamento dos usuários.


Requisitos e qualificações


  • Conhecimentos sólidos de NodeJS e React
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de HTML e CSS;
  • Conhecimentos sólidos do sistema de controle de versão Git;
  • Visão sobre design patterns (Criacionais, Estruturais e Comportamentais);
  • Domínio de boas práticas de desenvolvimento de software (DRY, KISS, TDA, SoC, SOLID);
  • Experiência com testes unitários em JavaScript;
  • Domínio de design de APIs REST (preferencialmente com o framework Express);
  • Visão do modelo arquitetural de micro-serviços;
  • Experiência com design responsivo (media queries, propriedades relativas, flexbox, CSS grid);
  • Conhecimentos sólidos de JavaScript e domínio dos paradigmas orientado a objetos e funcional da linguagem;
  • Conhecimento sobre GraphQL (preferencialmente com o framework Apollo);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoração (métricas de performance e erros);
  • Experiência com alguma ferramenta de CI/CD (preferencialmente GitLab CI);
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de hint/lint (preferencialmente ESLint).

title: Young Professional – IT Recruiter - Remote
description:
At INDI, we're passionate about empowering individuals and businesses worldwide. Our cutting-edge recruiters connect leading companies with top talent, fostering a dynamic environment where innovation thrives. Join us in shaping the future of work.


Overview of the role


The Young Professional – IT Recruiter position focuses on launching your career in talent acquisition within a global tech company. This role involves supporting end-to-end recruitment processes and developing sourcing and interviewing skills alongside experienced recruiters. You'll participate in the full recruitment cycle from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination while building talent pipelines and collaborating with hiring teams.


Key responsibilities


- Supporting the full recruitment cycle, from job posting and sourcing to screening and interview coordination.

- Sourcing candidates through job boards, LinkedIn, and other platforms to build a strong talent pipeline.

- Reviewing resumes and conducting initial screening calls to assess candidate profiles and interest.

- Coordinating interviews between candidates and hiring managers, ensuring a smooth experience for all parties.

- Maintaining and updating candidate records in the ATS, keeping data accurate and up to date.

- Collaborating with senior recruiters and hiring teams to understand role requirements and refine search strategies.


Requirements


- Educational Background: Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Business, or a related field — or currently pursuing one.

- Career Interest: Strong interest in IT recruitment and talent acquisition.

- Professional Attitude: Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable managing multiple tasks simultaneously.

- Core Skills: Good communication and interpersonal skills.

- Language Proficiency: Advanced level of English.



Benefits:

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Tailored Compensation: Personalize your earnings to suit your financial goals.

- Tech-Driven Tools: Access cutting-edge resources for seamless collaboration and productivity.

- Autonomous Workflow: Take control of your schedule to achieve work-life balance.

- Well-being: Enjoy generous leave policies for rest and rejuvenation.

- Diversity & Inclusion: Thrive in a diverse and inclusive environment.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Technology Manager (Licensed Entities)
description:
About Revolut


People deserve more from their money. More visibility, more control, and more freedom. Since 2015, Revolut has been on a mission to deliver just that. Our powerhouse of products — including spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more — help our 70+ million customers get more from their money every day.


As we continue our lightning-fast growth, 2 things are essential to our success: our people and our culture. In recognition of our outstanding employee experience, we've been certified as a Great Place to Work™. So far, we have 13,000+ people working around the world, from our offices and remotely, to help us achieve our mission. And we're looking for more brilliant people. People who love building great products, redefining success, and turning the complexity of a chaotic world into the simplicity of a beautiful solution.


About the role


Our Technology team builds the systems and experiences that keep Revolut moving forward. From the infrastructure behind our innovative app to the features used by millions of people around the world, they bring sharp thinking, speed, and a focus on meaningful impact to everything they do.

We're looking for a Technology Manager to partner closely with local and global teams across Operations, Product, Risk, and Compliance on technology initiatives.


You'll ensure local technology frameworks, systems, and governance align with both group standards and Brazilian regulatory expectations.


Up to shape what's next in finance? Let's get in touch.


What you'll be doing


  • Overseeing the implementation and evolution of the local technology architecture
  • Contributing to the execution of the IT and data strategy
  • Collaborating with global teams on technology transformations and system migrations
  • Supporting IT governance processes, including documentation and reporting for local regulatory requirements
  • Coordinating with internal stakeholders on technology initiatives related to regulatory compliance
  • Helping ensure systems are scalable, reliable, and aligned with group technology standards
  • Supporting operational processes and technology frameworks required for regulated financial entities in Brazil


What you'll need


  • 5+ years of experience in technology, IT architecture, or technology governance within financial services or fintech
  • Familiarity with regulatory and security requirements in Brazil, including cybersecurity, outsourcing, operational risk management, and data protection
  • A bachelor's degree or equivalent in a relevant field, such as engineering, computer science, or information systems
  • Great organisational and time management skills
  • Knowledge of IT systems, infrastructure, or technology governance frameworks
  • Solid analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Fluency in English


Building a global financial super app isn’t enough. Our Revoluters are a priority, and that’s why in 2021 we launched our inaugural D&I Framework, designed to help us thrive and grow everyday. We're not just doing this because it's the right thing to do. We’re doing it because we know that seeking out diverse talent and creating an inclusive workplace is the way to create exceptional, innovative products and services for our customers. That’s why we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and experiences to join this multicultural, hard-working team.


Important notice for candidates:

Job scams are on the rise. Please keep these guidelines in mind when applying for any open roles.

• Only apply through official Revolut channels. We don’t use any third-party services or platforms for our recruitment.

• Always double-check the emails you receive. Make sure all communications are being done through official Revolut emails, with an @revolut.com domain.

We won't ask for payment or personal financial information during the hiring process. If anyone does ask you for this, it’s a scam. Report it immediately.

I confirm I have disclosed if applicable any previous employment with Revolut. I accept that if any of the information given by me in this application is in any way false or incorrect, my application may be rejected, any offer of employment may be withdrawn or my employment with Revolut may be terminated summarily or I may be dismissed. By submitting this application, I agree that my personal data will be processed in accordance with Revolut's Candidate Privacy Notice

title: Senior Back End java engineer
description:
Senior Backend Java Engineer with Devops experience

Shift Timings: USA, PST (Pacific Standard Time)

Location: Remote (Brazil). Contract


We're seeking a seasoned Backend Java Engineer who can own services end-to-end, from development through production infrastructure management.


What You'll Do:


Design and build scalable APIs and backend services using Java

Implement security best practices including authentication, authorization, and secure coding

Develop event-driven architectures using Kafka

Design and optimize PostgreSQL databases

Manage infrastructure as code using Terraform

Deploy and orchestrate services with Kubernetes


What We're Looking For:


10+ years of Java development experience (Spring Boot preferred)

Strong API development and RESTful design skills

Hands-on experience with Kafka and PostgreSQL

Proven ability with Terraform and Kubernetes

Security-minded approach to development

Experience with microservices architecture

Ability to own projects from concept to production

title: Desenvolvedor .Net Pleno
description:
A FCamara está em busca de uma pessoa Desenvolvedora Back-End .NET - Pleno, para atuar em parceria com o maior Banco de Investimentos da América Latina, especializado em capital de investimento, de risco, além de gerenciamento de patrimônio e ativos globais.

Responsabilidades e atribuições:

  • Modelar arquiteturas de software em nuvem;
  • Ter conhecimento das tecnologias utilizadas pela equipe;
  • Ter capacidade de medir esforços e definir prazos de implementação;
  • Saber lidar com pressão de prazos;
  • Solucionar problemas que surgem durante os projetos;
  • Habilidade de gerenciar conflitos e expectativas;
  • Proatividade.

Requisitos e qualificações:

Hard Skills:

  • Experiencia com nuvem (AWS, GCP, Azure, etc) (Mínimo de 1 ano);
  • Experiência com .NET (C#) (Mais de 3 anos);
  • Experience com banco de dados relacional (SQLServer, MySql, Postgres) (Mais de 3 anos);
  • Design Patterns;
  • Experiência com testes unitários (TDD);
  • Conhecimento em GIT;
  • Conhecimento de metodologias ágeis (Scrum);
  • Conhecimento em Docker, Kubernets;
  • Conhecimento em frameworks de messageria (Kafka, ActiveMQ, RabbitMQ, etc..);
  • Boa comunicação e trabalho em equipe;
  • Capacidade de escrever código robusto, testável e validado;
  • Conhecimento em aplicações que precisem responder em alta disponibilidade e alta performance.



Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento de Mercado Financeiro;
  • Experiência com ferramentas de Code Quality (sonar);
  • Experiência com ferramentas de APM (Dynatrace, AppDynamics, DataDog, etc...);
  • Conhecimento em Prometheus, metricas e monitoramento;
  • Experiência com aplicações SPA;
  • Conhecimento em ElasticSearch, Apache Lucene e GraphQL;
  • Experiência trabalhando com implantação e gerenciamento de nuvem;
  • Experiência com gerenciamento e implantação de CI/CD.



Soft Skills:

  • Raciocínio lógico e capacidade analítica;
  • Boa Comunicação;
  • Espírito de equipe e capacidade de resolução de conflitos;
  • Ter capacidade de comunicação com diversos perfis de stakeholders;
  • Habilidade de trabalhar em equipes ágeis e multidisciplinares;
  • Criatividade e Proatividade para imaginar diferentes cenários de uso das aplicações;
  • Organização.

- 6+ years of experience working as a developer.

- 5+ years of experience working as a Data Scientist.

- Proficient with analysis, troubleshooting, and problem solving.

- Advanced English level.

- Flexibility: Choose where and how you work for enhanced creativity and innovation.

- Collaboration: Engage with industry leaders for collective growth.

- Development: Access mentorship and growth opportunities for continuous advancement.


If you are interested in being part of a team composed of the best professionals and working 100% goal-oriented in an innovative environment, but with the structure and resources of a multinational market leader, do not hesitate to apply!

title: Senior Full Stack Engineer
description:
Senior Full Stack Developer (Frontend Focus)


About the Role

We're looking for a senior full-stack developer with a strong frontend orientation who is passionate about building modern, polished user interfaces — and who actively leverages generative AI tools to do so faster and better. You'll own the frontend experience end-to-end while contributing meaningfully to backend systems built in Python.


What We're Looking For:

Hands-on experience with React and are comfortable working across the modern frontend ecosystem (Vue, Svelte, Angular, or similar). You understand the fundamentals — HTML, CSS, JavaScript/TypeScript, responsive design, accessibility — and use frameworks as tools rather than crutches. You are fluent in AI-assisted development. You use tools like Cursor, GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar AI coding platforms as a core part of your workflow — not as a novelty, but as a productivity multiplier. You can articulate how AI changes the way you architect, prototype, and ship frontend code. Ideally, you're genuinely excited about AI and follow the space closely.

On the backend, you bring strong Python skills. You've built APIs, worked with frameworks like FastAPI, Django, or Flask, and are comfortable with databases, authentication, and deployment. You don't just \"know some Python\" — you can design and build backend services confidently.


Key Requirements:

  • Deep expertise in React; working knowledge of at least one other modern frontend framework Strong command of TypeScript, modern CSS, and responsive/accessible design
  • Demonstrated active use of generative AI coding tools (Cursor, Copilot, Claude Code, etc.)
  • Strong Python backend skills — experience building APIs, working with databases, and deploying services
  • Comfort with the full stack: you can go from a Figma mockup to a deployed feature independently


Nice to Have Experience

  • Building AI-powered features or integrating LLM APIs into products
  • Familiarity with modern deployment and DevOps practices (Docker, CI/CD, cloud platforms)
